findings.entity: second neon window sign left of the 'OPEN' sign (night interior wide)
findings.description: The lit neon sign in the left window consistently reads as a red vertical bar, an occluded glyph and an 'O' ('|?O') in every night wide shot (00:18.7-00:44.9). Part of it sits behind a window mullion, but the visible letters do not make a plausible word.
